// This reader accepts one decimal exit status and an optional final line feed.
// Supply api/rmd0.rmd, api/rmd0_host.rmd, and api/rmd0_x64.rmd to build it.

extern fn file_open(path: *u8, mode: *u8) -> *u8 = "fopen";
extern fn file_close(file: *u8) -> i32 = "fclose";
extern fn text_length(text: *u8) -> usize = "strlen";

record AnswerTree {
    parsed: RmdUnit;
    declaration: RmdDecl;
    result_type: RmdTypeSyntax;
    block: RmdStmt;
    returning: RmdStmt;
    add: RmdExpr;
    left: RmdExpr;
    right: RmdExpr;
}

fn read_answer(ctx: *RmdContext, source: *RmdSource) -> *RmdDecl {
    var value: u64 = 0u64;
    var index: usize = 0usize;
    while index < (*source).size {
        var byte: u8 = (*source).bytes[index];
        if byte == 10u8 && index + 1usize == (*source).size { break; }
        if byte < 48u8 || byte > 57u8 {
            rmd_set_error(ctx, source, index, "expected a decimal digit");
            return null(*RmdDecl);
        }
        value = value * 10u64 + (byte - 48u8) as u64;
        if value > 255u64 {
            rmd_set_error(ctx, source, index, "exit status exceeds 255");
            return null(*RmdDecl);
        }
        index = index + 1usize;
    }
    if index == 0usize {
        rmd_set_error(ctx, source, index, "expected an exit status");
        return null(*RmdDecl);
    }
    var tree: *AnswerTree = rmd_try_alloc(ctx, sizeof(AnswerTree), alignof(AnswerTree)) as *AnswerTree;
    if tree == null(*AnswerTree) { return null(*RmdDecl); }
    var name: *RmdName = rmd_try_intern(ctx, "answer", 6usize);
    if name == null(*RmdName) {
        return null(*RmdDecl);
    }
    var location: RmdLoc = make RmdLoc { source: source, offset: 0usize };
    (*tree).result_type.kind = RMD_T_I32;
    (*tree).result_type.loc = location;
    (*tree).declaration.kind = RMD_D_FUNCTION;
    (*tree).declaration.loc = location;
    (*tree).declaration.name = name;
    (*tree).declaration.link_name = "rmd_stage_answer";
    (*tree).declaration.unit_identity = (*source).identity;
    (*tree).declaration.identity = 1u64;
    (*tree).declaration.syntax_type = &(*tree).result_type;
    (*tree).declaration.body = &(*tree).block;
    (*tree).block.kind = RMD_S_BLOCK;
    (*tree).block.body = &(*tree).returning;
    (*tree).returning.kind = RMD_S_RETURN;
    (*tree).returning.expr = &(*tree).add;
    (*tree).add.kind = RMD_E_BINARY;
    (*tree).add.op = RMD_OP_ADD;
    (*tree).add.left = &(*tree).left;
    (*tree).add.right = &(*tree).right;
    (*tree).left.kind = RMD_E_INTEGER;
    (*tree).left.literal_type = RMD_T_I32;
    (*tree).left.integer = value;
    (*tree).right.kind = RMD_E_INTEGER;
    (*tree).right.literal_type = RMD_T_I32;
    (*tree).parsed.source = source;
    (*tree).parsed.declarations = &(*tree).declaration;
    (*ctx).units = &(*tree).parsed;
    (*ctx).last_unit = &(*tree).parsed;
    return &(*tree).declaration;
}

fn lower_expression(emitter: *RmdX64Emitter, expression: *RmdExpr) -> bool {
    if (*expression).kind == RMD_E_BINARY && (*expression).op == RMD_OP_ADD &&
       (*(*expression).type).kind == RMD_T_I32 &&
       (*(*expression).right).kind == RMD_E_INTEGER && (*(*expression).right).integer == 0u64 {
        if !rmd_x64_try_emit_expression(emitter, (*expression).left) { return false; }
        return rmd_x64_write(emitter, "\t# stage: add zero\n");
    }
    return rmd_x64_try_emit_expression(emitter, expression);
}

fn compile_answer(ctx: *RmdContext, source: *RmdSource, output: *u8) -> bool {
    var entry: *RmdDecl = read_answer(ctx, source);
    if entry == null(*RmdDecl) { return false; }
    if !rmd_collect(ctx) || !rmd_resolve(ctx) || !rmd_check(ctx) { return false; }
    var program: *RmdX64Program = null(*RmdX64Program);
    if !rmd_x64_prepare(ctx, &program, null(*RmdDecl)) { return false; }
    var file: *u8 = file_open(output, "wb");
    if file == null(*u8) {
        rmd_set_error(ctx, source, 0usize, "cannot open assembly output");
        return false;
    }
    var operations: RmdX64Ops = make RmdX64Ops {
        expression: lower_expression,
        place: null(fn(*RmdX64Emitter,*RmdExpr)->bool),
        statement: null(fn(*RmdX64Emitter,*RmdStmt)->bool)
    };
    var success: bool = rmd_x64_emit_program_with_ops(program, file, &operations);
    if file_close(file) != 0i32 {
        rmd_set_error(ctx, source, 0usize, "cannot close assembly output");
        return false;
    }
    return success;
}

fn main(argc: i32, argv: **u8) -> i32 {
    if argc != 3i32 {
        rmd0_host_write_stream(2u32, "usage: stage INPUT OUTPUT\n", 26usize);
        return 1i32;
    }
    var bytes: *u8 = null(*u8);
    var size: usize = 0usize;
    if rmd0_host_read_file(argv[1usize], &bytes, &size) != 0i32 {
        rmd0_host_write_stream(2u32, "cannot read input\n", 18usize);
        return 1i32;
    }
    var source: RmdSource = make RmdSource { path: argv[1usize], bytes: bytes, size: size, identity: 1u64 };
    var ctx: RmdContext = uninit;
    rmd_context_init(&ctx, null(*RmdAllocator));
    var success: bool = compile_answer(&ctx, &source, argv[2usize]);
    if !success {
        var error_text: *u8 = &ctx.error[0usize];
        rmd0_host_write_stream(2u32, error_text, text_length(error_text));
        rmd0_host_write_stream(2u32, "\n", 1usize);
    }
    rmd_context_destroy(&ctx);
    rmd0_host_free(bytes);
    if !success { return 1i32; }
    return 0i32;
}
